attribution: per Person GT: mean squared selected P5 activation weighted by canonical fractional GT feature mask; RGB input-gradient L2; no signed-activation cancellation
attribution_smoothing: full native image 3x3 average before normalization; inside-GT Q10/Q90; raw uncut maps retained
normalization: clip[0,1] using each GT Q10/Q90; reject/report degenerate rather than invent guidance
multi_person: pixelwise max of per-GT normalized Q and center weights, no additive amplitude
fusion_literal: eta+(1-eta)*(rho*Q+(1-rho)*W_center), W_center already contains eta; higher effective floor is reported, not silently rewritten
global_bound: original8/4/0 retained for all soft weights
uniform_control: per-image constant coefficient matching B mean pre-image-clamp perturbation energy across same2EOT; diagnostic control only, no validation/optimization
top_k: exact10/20percent within Person; tie-break by original pixel index, report flat/tie limits
protection: original full S0 loss including Frozen background/relation/retention/orth/raw regularizers and true differentiable Adaptive update; main output gradient wrt operator delta; auxiliary attack excludes retention/orth
gradient_attribution_limit: new fixed train input/RNG at recorded S0 final active Fourier, not historical optimizer replay or causal victim evidence
nt_proxy: frozen decoded GT evidence mean top100 sqrt(classprob)*IoU^6; not AP or full native detection loss
batch_data_order: fixed sample IDs sorted, groups16; attribution padded to same parent batch geometry
manifest_binding_note: SHA of committed LF bytes; Windows working tree may use CRLF, parsed sample IDs/GT unchanged
